objective: Required check selection picks the newest run by timestamp and follows API pagination, so a stale run cannot win and a required check past page one is not reported missing.
decision_supported: Is the last run in the API response the latest? No: response order is not time order, which made a green commit red and a red one green.
acceptance: The newest run per name is selected by completed_at, falling back to started_at.
A run with no timestamps sorts before one that has them.
Check runs are read across pages until a short page or total_count is reached.
stop_conditions: The change would need a GitHub API version change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Following pagination costs extra requests on a busy commit; the page count is bounded.
